tools.name: delete_expired_holds
tools.description: Permanently deletes all seat holds for an event whose hold time has expired, so the seats are no longer reserved in the database.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the event whose expired holds should be deleted

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import time
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ticketing")
DB = "ticketing.db"


@mcp.tool()
def delete_expired_holds(event_id: int) -> dict:
    now = int(time.time())
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        cur = con.execute(
            "DELETE FROM seat_holds WHERE event_id = ? AND expires_at < ?",
            (event_id, now),
        )
        con.commit()
        n = cur.rowcount
    finally:
        con.close()
    return {"event_id": event_id, "deleted": n}

tools.name: archive_event_and_run_settlement
tools.description: Moves all tickets of a finished event from the active tickets table into the archive table, then runs the settlement script for that event.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys

DB = "ticketing.db"


def archive_event_and_run_settlement(event_id: int, script_path: str) -> dict:
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = con.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO tickets_archive SELECT * FROM tickets WHERE event_id = ?",
        (event_id,),
    )
    moved = cur.rowcount
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM tickets WHERE event_id = ?", (event_id,))
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, script_path, "--event-id", str(event_id)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )
    return {
        "event_id": event_id,
        "tickets_archived": moved,
        "exit_code": proc.returncode,
        "stdout": proc.stdout[-2000:],
        "stderr": proc.stderr[-2000:],
    }

tools.name: revoke_box_office_staff
tools.description: Removes a staff member's box office role for an event and deletes their active scanner access tokens for that event.

params.name: staff_id
params.description: ID of the staff member to remove

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool

DB = "ticketing.db"


@function_tool
def revoke_box_office_staff(event_id: int, staff_id: int) -> str:
    if event_id <= 0 or staff_id <= 0:
        return "error: invalid event_id or staff_id"
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = con.execute(
        "DELETE FROM event_roles WHERE event_id = ? AND staff_id = ?",
        (event_id, staff_id),
    )
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        con.close()
        return "error: staff member has no role for this event"
    con.execute(
        "DELETE FROM scanner_tokens WHERE event_id = ? AND staff_id = ?",
        (event_id, staff_id),
    )
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    return "revoked"

tools.name: get_event_sales_report
tools.description: Returns a sales summary for an event, including tickets sold per tier, revenue, remaining capacity and the most recent orders.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the event to report on

params.name: recent_limit
params.description: Number of recent orders to include (1-50)

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from agents import function_tool

DB = "ticketing.db"


@function_tool
def get_event_sales_report(event_id: int, recent_limit: int = 10) -> dict:
    recent_limit = max(1, min(recent_limit, 50))
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB)) as con:
        con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        with closing(con.cursor()) as cur:
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT name, venue, starts_at, capacity FROM events WHERE id = ?",
                (event_id,),
            )
            ev = cur.fetchone()
            if ev is None:
                return {"error": "event not found"}
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT tier, COUNT(*) AS sold, SUM(price_cents) AS revenue "
                "FROM tickets WHERE event_id = ? AND status = 'sold' "
                "GROUP BY tier",
                (event_id,),
            )
            tiers = [
                {
                    "tier": r["tier"],
                    "sold": r["sold"],
                    "revenue": (r["revenue"] or 0) / 100,
                }
                for r in cur.fetchall()
            ]
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT id, buyer_email, total_cents, created_at FROM orders "
                "WHERE event_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?",
                (event_id, recent_limit),
            )
            orders = [
                {
                    "order_id": r["id"],
                    "buyer": r["buyer_email"],
                    "total": r["total_cents"] / 100,
                    "created_at": r["created_at"],
                }
                for r in cur.fetchall()
            ]
    total_sold = sum(t["sold"] for t in tiers)
    total_rev = sum(t["revenue"] for t in tiers)
    return {
        "event": ev["name"],
        "venue": ev["venue"],
        "starts_at": ev["starts_at"],
        "capacity": ev["capacity"],
        "total_sold": total_sold,
        "remaining": ev["capacity"] - total_sold,
        "total_revenue": total_rev,
        "tiers": tiers,
        "recent_orders": orders,
    }
